answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit to an identity polynomial evaluated for each epoch. RLN proofs bind messages to a nullifier and rate-limit slot; using the same slot twice exposes distinct Shamir shares, allowing recovery of the registered secret key and verifiable, instantaneous collateral slashing. Semaphore membership proofs conceal identity for honest messages. Epochs may be named nadir, canyon, and timber; their labels do not alter the enforcement rule.
